svg.text: Customer HAS-A Bank Account — A Java Banking System Example
⑥ HAS-A RELATION — UML CLASS DIAGRAM
Customer object now CONTAINS the Account object
WHY IS THIS A HAS-A RELATIONSHIP?
• A Customer is NOT an Account (no inheritance).
• A Customer OWNS / USES an Account object.
• Therefore, Customer contains a reference to Account
• This represents Association — a HAS-A relationship,
Solid line with a hollow (empty) triangle
arrowhead pointing to the parent class.
A simple solid line connecting two independent
Solid line with a hollow diamond at the 'whole'
end — weak HAS-A (parts can exist independently).
Solid line with a filled diamond at the 'whole'
end — strong HAS-A (parts cannot exist independently).
This example uses a plain ASSOCIATION line ( HAS-A )
UML Class Diagram Reference • Object-Oriented Programming • Association (HAS-A) Relationship
